definition: The task of identifying and classifying the semantic relationships between entities mentioned in text.
details: Relation extraction is often paired with entity extraction to automatically construct or populate knowledge graphs from unstructured documents.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. Think of it this way: The task of identifying and classifying the semantic relationships between entities mentioned in text. And here is the clever part: Relation extraction is often paired with entity extraction to automatically construct or populate knowledge graphs from unstructured documents. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Relation Extraction — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
